/obj/item/storage/belt/bandolier.name: bandolier
/obj/item/storage/belt/bandolier.reason: Holds 24 shotgun or heavy revolver rounds on the belt. A shotgun user's best friend, and empty when you get it.

/obj/item/storage/belt/chameleon.name: toolbelt
/obj/item/storage/belt/chameleon.reason: Looks like another belt and holds what a toolbelt holds. A disguise piece.

/obj/item/storage/belt/champion.name: championship belt
/obj/item/storage/belt/champion.reason: A trophy belt that holds one luchador mask.

/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack.name: fannypack
/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack.reason: Three small slots and a dorky look.

/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/black.name: black fannypack
/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/black.reason: Three small slots and a dorky look.

/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/blue.name: blue fannypack
/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/blue.reason: Three small slots and a dorky look.

/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/cummerb.name: cummerbund
/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/cummerb.reason: A formal sash with three small slots.

/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/green.name: green fannypack
/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/green.reason: Three small slots and a dorky look.

/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/red.name: red fannypack
/obj/item/storage/belt/fannypack/red.reason: Three small slots and a dorky look.

/obj/item/storage/belt/grenade.name: grenadier belt
/obj/item/storage/belt/grenade.reason: Holds 30 grenades or charges on the belt, far more than any other belt. Comes empty. No shop, ruin or played hull has it.

/obj/item/storage/belt/holster.name: shoulder holster
/obj/item/storage/belt/holster.reason: Holds one pistol on the belt. A pistol fits in a bag anyway.

/obj/item/storage/belt/holster/detective.name: detective's holster
/obj/item/storage/belt/holster/detective.reason: Holds three pistols, revolvers or their magazines on the belt. A tidy sidearm rig, no more. One ruin has it.

/obj/item/storage/belt/holster/energy.name: energy shoulder holsters
/obj/item/storage/belt/holster/energy.reason: Holds two energy pistols on the belt. Nice for a disabler and a sidearm.

/obj/item/storage/belt/holster/nukie.name: operative holster
/obj/item/storage/belt/holster/nukie.reason: Holds any two guns on the belt, rifles included, or a gun and a magazine. Swapping to a full second gun beats reloading. One ruin has it.

/obj/item/storage/belt/janitor.name: janibelt
/obj/item/storage/belt/janitor.reason: An empty belt for cleaning gear.

/obj/item/storage/belt/medical.name: medical belt
/obj/item/storage/belt/medical.reason: An empty belt for medical gear.

/obj/item/storage/belt/medical/paramedic.name: EMT belt
/obj/item/storage/belt/medical/paramedic.reason: Field starter kit: crew sensor, gauze, bone gel, surgical tape, a syringe and two bottles.

/obj/item/storage/belt/military.name: chest rig
/obj/item/storage/belt/military.reason: Seven slots for any small item: magazines, grenades, medipens. More open than a security belt.

/obj/item/storage/belt/military/assault.name: assault belt
/obj/item/storage/belt/military/assault.reason: Six slots for any small item. A chest rig with one slot fewer.

/obj/item/storage/belt/military/snack.name: tactical snack rig
/obj/item/storage/belt/military/snack.reason: Six slots for snacks and drinks.

/obj/item/storage/belt/mining.name: explorer's webbing
/obj/item/storage/belt/mining.reason: Six slots that take almost anything an away team carries: pickaxe, medical stacks, pills, scanners, tools.

/obj/item/storage/belt/mining/alt.name: explorer's webbing
/obj/item/storage/belt/mining/alt.reason: Six slots that take almost anything an away team carries: pickaxe, medical stacks, pills, scanners, tools.

/obj/item/storage/belt/mining/vendor.name: explorer's webbing
/obj/item/storage/belt/mining/vendor.reason: Explorer's webbing with a shelter capsule inside. Bought with a mining voucher.

/obj/item/storage/belt/security.name: security belt
/obj/item/storage/belt/security.reason: Five slots for ammo, grenades, batons and cuffs. Comes empty.

/obj/item/storage/belt/security/full.name: security belt
/obj/item/storage/belt/security/full.reason: Stun baton, flash, flashbang, pepper spray and cuffs: a complete kit for stunning and cuffing one person up close. The flashbang makes it yellow, and it's the only way to buy a baton.

/obj/item/storage/belt/security/webbing.name: security webbing
/obj/item/storage/belt/security/webbing.reason: Six slots for ammo, grenades, batons and cuffs. A security belt with one more slot.

/obj/item/storage/belt/sheath/grass_sabr.name: sabre sheath
/obj/item/storage/belt/sheath/grass_sabr.reason: A grass sheath for one parsnip sabre, empty when crafted.

/obj/item/storage/belt/sheath/sabre.name: sabre sheath
/obj/item/storage/belt/sheath/sabre.reason: An officer's sabre (ignores most armor, blocks half of melee, no help against bullets) in its sheath. Too little damage to be more than green. Starts in captains' lockers on 9 hulls.

/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/atmostech.name: toolbelt
/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/atmostech.reason: Plain hand tools on a belt. Every engineer starts with one.

/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/chief/ful.name: chief engineer's toolbelt
/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/chief/ful.reason: Power tools, an experimental welder and a multitool. The best work belt, and still only a work belt.

/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/full.name: toolbelt
/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/full.reason: Plain hand tools on a belt. Every engineer starts with one.

/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/full/engi.name: toolbelt
/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/full/engi.reason: Plain hand tools on a belt. Every engineer starts with one.

/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/full/indu.name: toolbelt
/obj/item/storage/belt/utility/full/indu.reason: Plain tools plus an inducer, which recharges a dead APC or cell by hand. Handy after a power loss.

method: A filled belt rates as its contents. An empty belt is none unless its slots change what you can carry into a fight, such as grenades, spare guns or magazines. No formula.
